profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Knowledge Path Solutions
profile.summary: I am a seasoned web developer with over 14 years experience building and maintaining e-commerce websites and software systems. I am a highly proficient Java programmer with strong object-oriented design and programming skills. I am also a true full-stack developer, capable of digging into the minutia of CSS and JavaScript but just as comfortable working in the database and back-end systems. I enjoy learning new technologies and using them to solve interesting problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed high-volume e-commerce site for client TJ Maxx, built on the Oracle Commerce Java-based platform. The project launched on schedule and with minimal problems in September 2013. Primary areas of responsibility included
- Multi-step AJAX based checkout process
- Mobile site based on jQuery Mobile framework
- Social media integrations
- Profile and account management
- Security fixes

Post-launch, I have continued to work on the TJ Maxx site doing feature enhancements and bug fixes. 
- Enhanced site search to perform an initial search against an index of brand names, and redirect to a “not so fast” page if found
- Added coupon form to the checkout process, integrating with the existing AJAX-based checkout flow

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Extended existing suite of shopping cart XML-RPC/JSON-RPC based services.  Added support for cart item deletion, and cart item update.

Implemented services for retrieving user profile information and creation of new user profiles.

Implemented OAuth 2.0 authorization and authentication for protection of profile-based resources.
- Coded full integration with Mashery's JSON-RPC API for access token management
- Created multi-page login and scope authorization flow using Spring MVC
- Implemented framework for scope-based access control to individual services, integrating with Spring Security

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Implemented new checkout process for iPad-based web application used by in-store employees assisting customers. 
- Implemented multi-tender payment (split purchase across multiple credit cards).
- Made checkout process “re-entrant,” i.e. allowing users to return and edit pages in the flow then return to the stage from which they came.  This was a substantial improvement over the existing checkout experience.
- Extended ATG app server to support contextual inline form error messages.
- Added support for cash and check payment.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Rewrote web-based book and magazine library pages
- Tracked down memory leak that was impairing site performance.
- Found and removed major performance bottleneck that was slowing library pages down.
- Greatly improved presentation and usability of web-based library.

Implemented new registration flow with free trial subscription
- Integrated with Google's reCAPTCHA service to prevent scamming.
- Reused core implementation to implement new XMLRPC services to enable free subscription signup on iPad and iPhone.

Implemented Facebook OpenGraph tagging and “like” button on magazine offer page.

Designed and implemented RESTful web services to export newsstand catalog data for use in the iPad shopping application. 

Integrated with Apple App Store to validate and fulfill in-app purchase of magazine issues and subscriptions.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Replaced Vivisimo with Apache Solr as primary search engine for commerce site
- Did initial research into viability of solution, determining indexing strategies
- Coded ATG-side Java integration to Solr server, including support for querying multiple cores

Designed and implemented ATG Nucleus and servlet-based MVC framework to front JSPs. Features included
- Dynamically generated, semantically meaningful SEO-friendly URLs
- Handling of non-display concerns in configuration and controller logic, including http/https status and login status requirements 

Ported ATG 7.1/DAS website to ATG 9.0p1 running on JBoss
- Wrote custom JBoss valve class to implement ATG-style resending of session cookies when sessionid comes in on the URL
- Fixed ancient NetPerceptions client libraries to work with JBoss class loader

Extended web-service based order capture mechanism to allow single-page checkout of softgood items from the main commerce site.

Created JavaScript-driven movie player environment for site streaming video system

Worked on major site redesign for eLuxury.com
- Integrated site with Scene7 image serving environment
- Created popup image viewer for Scene7 images with zoom, pan etc.
- AJAX/JSON integration with Scene7 for dynamic retrieval of image information based on product ID
- "Quick View" overlay feature, essentially a mini product detail page as popover window complete with size/color selection and AJAX add to cart

Mentored junior programmers through pair programming and formation of weekly reading group

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Implemented persistent shopping cart for Struts-based commerce website.

Fixed “broken back button” for AJAX-driven search system using YUI Browser History Manager utility.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Rewrote poorly performing JavaScript-driven product page using Google Web Toolkit
- Replaced front-loaded JSON data structure with RPC calls for just-in-time data retrieval.
- Replaced cryptic, undocumented Prototype-based DOM rendering code with well structured and documented Java code.
- Achieved up to 500% decrease in page rendering time.

Finished and deployed revamped checkout process
- Implemented all incomplete features.
- Found and fixed bugs, and implemented usability enhancements.
- Project launched successfully and on schedule, with no post-launch bugs reported.

Performed maintenance and bug fixes for both customer-facing and internal websites
- Implemented enhancements to product monogramming code, including new monogram entry forms and changes to order management code to store the new attributes.
- Fixed bugs in internal gift registry administration application.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Core developer on port of large commerce site from ASP to ATG, writing:
Shopping cart and checkout process
Product and category browsing
SQL-based advanced search feature
Customer account administration pages
Integration with existing video streaming service
Integration with third-party credit card processing service (CyberSource)

Technical lead on upgrade of ATG server version from 5.6.1 to 7.1

Wrote and maintained highly successful video streaming service

Integrated external search platform (Vivisimo) with ATG application server

Designed and coded page and content rendering system, featuring:
Engine for flexible rendering of pages or parts of pages using a building-block approach, based on data stored in a repository
Framework for selection of products for merchandising, including bridges to existing bestseller and recommendation systems and to ATG-specific query language RQL
Web-based application for administration of page content

Patched ATG's SQL-based JMS implementation, adding a dead message queue to prevent the dreaded "infinite message loop"

Localized for the DE locale and translated into German key portions of large commerce site, including checkout, emails and account administration pages

Worked on custom targeted email campaign software for marketing department
Co-wrote initial version of software in Java
Wrote application to identify and delete bounced messages via IMAP and custom mail headers
